text:
Jules (Growth): Quick sync  embargo lift currently set for Mon May 11 09:00 PT. Rafael says APAC desks want earlier local window. Need to confirm stagger plan by EOD.
Hana (PR): Can we do APAC T-2h (local) and EMEA at T-1h? That usually helps pickup.
Rafael (Intl): T-2h APAC ok, but we need translated one-pager and local reporter list. I can take translations for JP/KR by morning.
Jules (Growth): Good. Who's owning translations + review?
Tori (Design): I can produce localized social cards once copy is final. ETA 6 hours.
Eve (Legal): Reminder  don't use customer names in examples. Also avoid comparative claims without bench backup. Send methodology link to legal once final.
Hana (PR): We'll use conservative headline. Technical appendix will hold the benchmark details and raw numbers. Legal to review appendix too.
press-bot: detected external mention of "embargo" in public channel #random at 1765998000. Possible leak flagged.
Jules (Growth): Ugh. Thanks bot. Can someone paste link and confirm it's not ours?
Rafael (Intl): I looked  it's a generic tweet from a researcher, not our content. Still want to monitor.
Hana (PR): Plan: lockdown all PR drafts to "team only" on Google Drive. I'll DM reporters to confirm embargo. Also prep a short Q&A doc for press.
Sam (CEO): I'll prepare a 1-2 line top quote. Will post here.
Tori (Design): Quick question  do we use the same hero chart for all regions or localize axes/units?
Jules (Growth): Localize units where relevant (ms vs seconds) for clarity.
Hana (PR): Media training: have Liam (Eng) and Alex (Prod) on standby for technical calls. Also schedule a 30m pre-embargo lift briefing at T-10m.
Rafael (Intl): For APAC, earlier local release means we might have to provide embargoed assets to a handful of partners ahead of time. Legal ok with that?
Eve (Legal): Provide partners with NDAs if required. Keep list minimal.
press-bot: embargo-checklist: assets_locked=true, NDA_list=0, translations_pending=2.
Jules (Growth): Action items: Hana will lock drafts and start DMing reporters, Rafael will finalize translations, Tori will produce assets, Legal to confirm NDA list, Sam to post quote.
Hana (PR): Draft Q&A uploaded: //drive/press/qa_may11. DM if you need edit access.
Sam (CEO): Quote: "Our focus on predictable inference delivers practical improvements for teams deploying LLMs." Short and on-point. Use as needed.
Jules (Growth): Perfect. Hana, please confirm outreach cadence for APAC reporters (send at T-3h local?).
Hana (PR): I'll send initial heads-up at T-6h local, embargoed assets at T-3h.
Tori (Design): Uploaded 3 hero cards to //assets/press/may11_localized/. Noted units localization.
Rafael (Intl): JP/KR copies uploaded. CN team asked for a simplified summary; provisioning that now.
press-bot: monitor-mode=on. Will alert if public posts mention embargo keywords.
Hana (PR): Also prepare an internal comms email to Sales/Support at T-30m. Should contain talking points and escalation path.
Jules (Growth): I'll draft the internal note and share for review.
Eve (Legal): Appendix link please so I can sign off on methodology language.
Jules (Growth): Added appendix link to the draft blog. //blog/drafts/may11-benchmark.
Liam (Eng): (via DM to Hana) available for 60m after lift for follow-ups.
Hana (PR): Great. Our timeline final: APAC local lift T-2h, EMEA T-1h, HQ (PT) at 09:00. Pre-lift briefing T-10m. Internal comms T-30m. Assets locked and translations in place.
Sam (CEO): Good plan. Keep me looped for any high-profile interview requests.
press-bot: alert: unauthorized public mention removed from #random. No further actions required.
Jules (Growth): Thanks team  closing thread. Post updates here if anything changes. :rocket:
